q: Should UMP consent (Android/iOS) and ATT (iOS) stop firing in the first seconds of first launch, and how?
decision: Defer UMP form and ATT until the first rover tap in a session; keep ATT chained after UMP; keep consent-info refresh at launch; reject dropping ATT and second-launch deferral
reason: Owner asked to optimize, the What's New modal was already moved inline, ad revenue is negligible, and deferral is fully reversible while dropping ATT changes App Store privacy answers.

q: Which trigger should release the UMP/ATT consent prompts later than the first rover tap: tap count (in-memory or persisted), 45 s timer, or tap+timer hybrid?
decision: Release the prompts on the second rover tap overall, counted in AppSettings across sessions; the gate opens only on a tap, never at launch; reject the timer, the in-memory count and the hybrid
reason: Only a tap trigger keeps the prompt at a navigation moment; a timer can land over the fullscreen viewer, and an in-memory count never asks one-tap-per-session users.

q: Share on photo detail: share sheet via expect/actual, clipboard, or Android-first?
decision: Platform share sheet via existing ImageOperations; already implemented on both platforms, no new code
reason: Consistent with the repo: ImageOperations.shareImage exists and ImagesScreen already calls it

q: Facts: keep live Firestore, bundle JSON, or bundled snapshot plus Firestore override?
decision: Keep live Firestore reads; no bundled copy
reason: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md keeps shown-but-not-computed content in Firestore with no bundled copy; facts change several times a year

q: FactsRepositoryImpl swallows Firestore errors so fact cards silently do not appear; surface an error with retry, hide the section, or follow-up?
decision: Leave as is: failed facts load yields no fact cards, photos unaffected; no error UI
reason: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md says a failed Firestore fetch returns empty and remote content that has not arrived is a normal state, not an error

q: Daily Mars fact local notification: default off, on, or on with a first-launch prompt?
decision: Off by default; Daily Mars Fact switch in About > Updates; permission requested on toggle tap
reason: Anything that notifies is opt-in and notificationsEnabled already defaults to false

decision: C: on by default, with a one-time prompt at first launch before the first notification
reason: Owner: notifications and engagement features default on, gated by a one-time prompt; opt-in is reserved for sharing user data or costing the user something

q: When the new fastlane `android galaxy` lane adds a fresh binary, what should it do with binaries already attached to the Galaxy Store listing (seq 2/3/4, versionCodes 9/20/54)?
decision: A: leave existing binaries untouched, lane only adds the new one (decider lean, pending owner confirmation)
reason: deleting 2016/2019 binaries could cut off old devices Samsung still routes to them; hard to reverse

q: How to resolve Dependabot alert #52 (unsafe deserialization, kotlin-gradle-plugin < 2.4.20-Beta1) reached via buildSrc's kotlin-dsl plugin?
decision: A: override buildSrc's transitive KGP to 2.4.20 via buildscript classpath dependency in buildSrc/build.gradle.kts, accepting the resulting Gradle version-mismatch warning
reason: Consistent with the main build already on Kotlin 2.4.20, smallest and most reversible fix; removing buildSrc (B) is a disproportionate refactor for a security patch and doing nothing (C) leaves a fixable known CVE open

q: Default size limit for the full-resolution photo disk cache, and is it user-adjustable?
decision: Fixed about 200 MB, not adjustable; Clear cache is the only control
reason: Consistent with App.kt single fixed Coil config; unbounded cache unreliable on iOS

decision: C: no explicit limit; rely on Coil and OS defaults
reason: Owner: do not add limits or settings for a problem nobody has observed

q: While editing ImageOperations.ios.kt for Photos-save, fix the iPad share sheet anchor? Same change, follow-up, or separate commit
decision: Follow-up only; anchoring needs the button position passed through the ImageOperations interface, all platforms and the call site
reason: Fails the apply-now test; FormSheet works and does not crash

q: When does the What's New dialog open by itself: every version change, only highlighted releases, or never?
decision: Keep the existing gate: opens when an active release newer than the installed build is published and its nudge not dismissed; no auto-open after updating
reason: Implemented in WhatsNewViewModel.shouldShowDialog, pinned by WhatsNewGateTest, cited in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Published 5.0.0 notes contradict the code

q: Where should the new merge-dependabot skill live: global ~/.claude/skills or project .claude/skills?
reason: Skill is repo-agnostic and mirrors the global cleanup-branches skill; project skills here are MarsRoverPhotos-specific.

q: Pick banner copy and build, or present concepts and wait for approval?
decision: Present concepts, wait for owner approval of exact text before building
reason: Skill step 1 and the owner's ask-before rule require approval of user-visible copy before building.
